title: Holmes taught Joseph his first notes
summary: Joseph says that from across the river Holmes came to his home band and taught him clarinet, the first man to teach him a note.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: It was a different sound, you know? Yeah. Mmhmm. Did you ever work with Holmes? You say you did, huh?

Sure, I worked with Holmes. Holmes taught me. After I got the saxophone, in fact, I was, I was living on the other side of the river. And Holmes would live on this side of the river. Mmhmm. He used to come over there and we had a little band at home. Mmhmm. He used to come over there, taught me clarinet. The first man ever learned me a note. Oh.
